claims: More than 3 million bottles of eye drops manufactured by K.C. Pharmaceuticals were recalled in April 2026 due to potential contamination.

Key recalled products manufactured by K.C. Pharmaceuticals include Dry Eye Relief Eye Drops 0.5 fl. oz., Artificial Tears Sterile Lubricant Eye Drops 0.5 fl. oz., Sterile Eye Drops Original Formula 0.5 fl. oz., Sterile Eye Drops Redness Lubricant 0.5 fl. oz., Eye Drops Advanced Relief 0.5 fl. oz., Ultra Lubricating Eye Drops 0.5 fl. oz., Sterile Eye Drops AC 0.5 fl. oz., Sterile Eye Drops Soothing Tears 0.5 fl. oz.

The recalled products were sold under various store brand labels including CVS Health, Walgreens, Rite Aid, Walmart (Equate), Target (Up&Up), Leader (Cardinal Health), Rugby, Meijer, Harris Teeter, H-E-B, Kroger, Publix, Good Neighbor Pharmacy, Good Sense, Velocity Pharma.
The recall involves items with expiration dates between November 2023 and September 2025.
